What was the total revenue for Azure Mot:
-- Campaign period filter using car_sales aggregation
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS campaign_revenue
FROM car_sales
WHERE brand = 'Azure Motors'
  AND body_type = 'EV SUV'
  AND month IN ('2025-06','2025-07','2025-08','2025-09')
Which top 10 dealers had the highest pro:
-- Top dealers by profit for Q3 2025
SELECT TOP 10
    d.dealer_name,
    d.region,
    SUM(dpm.total_profit) AS q3_profit
FROM dealer_performance_monthly dpm
INNER JOIN dealers d ON dpm.dealer_id = d.dealer_id
WHERE dpm.month IN ('2025-07','2025-08','2025-09')
GROUP BY d.dealer_name, d.region
ORDER BY q3_profit DESC
How did incoming inventory change in Wes:
-- Compare inventory incoming during disruption period
SELECT
    d.region,
    i.month,
    AVG(i.incoming) AS avg_incoming
FROM inventory i
INNER JOIN dealers d ON i.dealer_id = d.dealer_id
WHERE d.region IN ('West','Pacific NW')
  AND i.month IN ('2025-08','2025-09')
GROUP BY d.region, i.month
ORDER BY d.region, i.month
What was the average margin percentage f:
-- Campaign margin analysis from car_sales
SELECT AVG(margin_pct) AS avg_margin
FROM car_sales
WHERE brand = 'Azure Motors'
  AND body_type = 'EV SUV'
  AND month IN ('2025-06','2025-07','2025-08','2025-09')
Which region had the highest stockout ri:
-- Stockout risk by region for September 2025
SELECT TOP 1
    d.region,
    AVG(dpm.stockout_risk_score) AS avg_risk
FROM dealer_performance_monthly dpm
INNER JOIN dealers d ON dpm.dealer_id = d.dealer_id
WHERE dpm.month = '2025-09'
GROUP BY d.region
ORDER BY avg_risk DESC
What is the customer sentiment distribut:
-- Sentiment breakdown for EV SUV models
SELECT
    f.sentiment,
    COUNT(*) AS feedback_count,
    CAST(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS DECIMAL(5,2)) AS percentage
FROM customer_feedback f
INNER JOIN models m ON f.model_id = m.model_id
WHERE m.body_type = 'EV SUV'
GROUP BY f.sentiment
ORDER BY feedback_count DESC
Show total units sold by body type in 20:
-- Units by body type for 2025
SELECT
    body_type,
    SUM(units) AS total_units
FROM car_sales
WHERE month LIKE '2025-%'
GROUP BY body_type
ORDER BY total_units DESC
Which top 10 models had the highest aver:
-- Top models by promo uplift during campaign
SELECT TOP 10
    m.model_name,
    m.brand,
    m.body_type,
    AVG(mpm.promo_uplift_pct) AS avg_uplift
FROM model_performance_monthly mpm
INNER JOIN models m ON mpm.model_id = m.model_id
WHERE mpm.promo_uplift_pct > 0
  AND mpm.month IN ('2025-06','2025-07','2025-08','2025-09')
GROUP BY m.model_name, m.brand, m.body_type
ORDER BY avg_uplift DESC
Compare campaign period (Jun-Sep 2025) v:
-- Campaign vs baseline comparison using car_sales
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN month IN ('2025-06','2025-07','2025-08','2025-09') THEN 'Campaign'
        WHEN month IN ('2025-03','2025-04','2025-05') THEN 'Baseline'
    END AS period,
    SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue,
    SUM(units) AS total_units,
    SUM(revenue) / NULLIF(SUM(units), 0) AS avg_transaction_value
FROM car_sales
WHERE brand = 'Azure Motors'
  AND body_type = 'EV SUV'
  AND month IN ('2025-03','2025-04','2025-05','2025-06','2025-07','2025-08','2025-09')
GROUP BY CASE
    WHEN month IN ('2025-06','2025-07','2025-08','2025-09') THEN 'Campaign'
    WHEN month IN ('2025-03','2025-04','2025-05') THEN 'Baseline'
END
Which dealers in West and Pacific NW reg:
-- Stockouts during logistics disruption
SELECT DISTINCT
    d.dealer_name,
    d.region,
    m.model_name,
    i.month,
    i.logistics_delay_factor
FROM inventory i
INNER JOIN dealers d ON i.dealer_id = d.dealer_id
INNER JOIN models m ON i.model_id = m.model_id
WHERE d.region IN ('West', 'Pacific NW')
  AND i.month IN ('2025-08', '2025-09')
  AND i.stockout_flag = 1
ORDER BY d.region, d.dealer_name, i.month
